title: Nelson Clark's band at the Lenox Club
summary: He took a job in a five or six piece band at Happy Rone's declining Lenox Club, where pay came in small nightly amounts.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Well, my stock went right up, because that same day a fellow come and gave me a job working at... A fellow named Clark -- Nelson Clark. He had a job at the Lenox Club, which was...at that time it was Happy Roane's(?) club. Happy Roane had a pretty big-time nightclub. But Happy had been messing with the money, and the club was on the downward trend when I got there. So I go up there to work with Nelson Clark, a little five- or six-piece band....

He played the guitar. One of them E-flat guitars; you know, he was an E-flat player, one of them things. So I come to find out if we was getting our money every night. We (?) get paid weekly. We was gettin' it
very weak, two dollars tonight, three dollars the next night, or whatever we could get. But you'd better get it every night.
